description: This file is a Perl script for manipulating and processing binary chunk files. It includes functions for reading, copying, and modifying the file data, specifically handling 64-bit file offsets, reading table-of-contents entries, and updating chunk data within the file.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from STDIN, with error handling.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Reads data from STDIN using get() and outputs it directly, used to copy raw bytes.

methods.name: unpack_quad
methods.description: Unpacks an 8-byte sequence into a 64-bit integer, handling platforms without 64-bit support by splitting into two 32-bit integers.

methods.name: pack_quad
methods.description: Packs a 64-bit integer into a 8-byte sequence with a zero high part, ensuring the round-trip integrity.
